# Mirantis

> Mirantis delivers AI infrastructure management and cloud-native solutions for building, deploying, and operating modern applications across hybrid multicloud environments.

Mirantis provides enterprise-grade platforms including k0rdent for infrastructure-as-a-service, GPU provisioning, and AI workloads, alongside Kubernetes training, application modernization services, and managed cloud operations. The company serves organizations modernizing legacy applications and building AI infrastructure at scale.

- k0rdent
